content:
Although it was overshadowed by the launch of iOS 27 this time, Apple also rolled out a new software update for AirPods this month. This update brings a long-awaited feature to supported AirPods models: custom EQ.

AirPods software details

The latest AirPods firmware version number is 9A350 for AirPods 5, and 9A348 for other models. The following AirPods models are eligible for this update:

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods 4
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation)
  • AirPods 5
  • AirPods 5 (Wireless Charging Case)
  • AirPods Pro 2 (Lightning and USB-C)
  • AirPods Max 2

Apple says that the AirPods firmware update will install automatically when your AirPods are charging and within Bluetooth range of an iPhone, iPad, or Mac that's connected to Wi-Fi. You can check the firmware version of your AirPods in the Settings app on your iPhone.

Custom EQ feature lands on AirPods

After installing the AirPods firmware update, you'll see a long-awaited new feature in the Settings app: custom EQ.

Thanks to the new custom EQ controls, you can now adjust the sound of your AirPods with more flexibility. In the Settings app, you can tune the bass, mid, and treble of your AirPods.

Apple explains: "AirPods are designed and engineered by Apple to faithfully reproduce audio the way it was meant to be heard — from music and TV shows to movies and phone calls. If you prefer a different sound profile, you can customise how AirPods sound when playing any audio."

While adjusting the custom EQ settings, you can play songs from Apple Music directly within the Settings app to hear the changes in real time.

This isn't exactly the most advanced equaliser feature — just a basic three-band system. But for AirPods users, Apple has finally delivered this long-awaited feature — even though most users will probably stick with the default settings.

You can find the new custom EQ feature in the Settings app under the Audio & Routing section of the AirPods page. All AirPods equipped with the H2 chip support this feature, including AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2.

Other iOS 27 AirPods features

Here are the other new features iOS 27 brings to AirPods:

  • Redesigned Settings app: In iOS 27, Apple has redesigned the AirPods interface in the Settings app. The controls have been reorganised, with separate menus for Hearing Health, Find My, Live Translation, and more.
  • Adaptive Audio slider: In the Settings app, there's now a new slider that lets you fine-tune Adaptive Audio mode further.
  • GymKit: Although GymKit has been around for years, it has always required pairing with an Apple Watch. As my colleague Zac noted, iOS 27 brings the full GymKit experience to the iPhone and AirPods Pro 3.
  • Precision Finding: You can now use Precision Finding in the Find My app on your Apple Watch to locate your AirPods Pro 3.
  • Siri AI: When paired with a compatible iPhone, AirPods can interact with Siri AI.

Wrap-up

Which new AirPods feature are you most excited to try? Will you give the new custom EQ a go? Let us know in the comments.
